idea-plugin.name: Maekom Mongo Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Maekom Mongo Lens provides a Zero-Config MongoDB & AWS DocumentDB Compass-style GUI directly inside IntelliJ IDEA Community & Ultimate.

  • Zero-Config Spring Boot YAML Discovery: Automatically parses single & multi-document application*.yml files, resolves ${VAR:default} placeholders and .env, and protects PRD environments with Read-Only lock.
  • Compass-Style Query Workspace & Smart Quick Filters: Multi-tab Find workspace with Filter/Project/Sort JSON editors, 5-group context menu with multi-selection Smart Quick Filter (=, !=, $in, $nin, Date $gte~$lte, AND/$or, $exists) & Sort, Smart $in builder, and Document Diff.
  • Read-Only Index Inspector & ESR Query Guide: Accurate MongoDB & AWS DocumentDB IXSCAN/COLLSCAN/UNKNOWN detection, unified cached index viewer, one-click Filter templates, and copy-only ESR createIndex recommendations.
  • AWS DocumentDB-Compatible Multi-Join View & Bidirectional Aggregation Builder: Star & Chain joins (A ⋈ B ⋈ C) with array-of-objects key paths, deterministic post-join paging, Unlimited mode (5,000-doc safety cap), and visual/raw Aggregation pipeline builder.
  • AES Field Decryption, In-App Updater & Real-Time KO/EN UI: Temporary plaintext decryption with auto-masking, GitHub Releases in-app updater, and instant Korean/English switching.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v0.3.1

  • Configurable Query Timeout (Default 40s) + Dual Timeout Guard & Guidance Popup: Added persistent Query Timeout (sec) (5–600s, default 40s) in the top-right Settings (⚙) menu via MongoLensSettings (PersistentStateComponent), pairing server-side maxTimeMS (with automatic AWS DocumentDB unsupported-option retry) with a client-side watchdog timer and a once-per-run TimeoutGuideDialog with a direct Open Timeout Settings button.
  • Per-Tab Isolated ▶ Find ↔ ■ Stop Toggle & Safe Client-Side Cancellation: Transforms the Run button into a red ■ Stop button during execution (strictly isolated per tab via monotonic runId tokens so late cleanup from a stopped query never clobbers a newly started query), safely cancelling futures and closing active MongoCursor instances without ever calling admin killOp.
  • Join Mode Toolbar Disabling with Tab-Switch Sync: Automatically disables single-collection-only inputs/actions (Filter/Project/Sort, Reset, Smart $in, Shell, Saved/History, Import JSON, Index Inspector) with clear tooltips while a Join View tab is active, keeping unified Run/Stop, Join Config, Copy Pipeline, Export, Limit, and Paging enabled and synchronized across tab switches.
  • Bidirectional Pre-Filter Join Engine & Real-Time MongoDB Compass-Compatible "Copy Pipeline": Pre-filters both base and target collections with schema-aware BSON typing before cross-matching keys via normalized numeric-safe hash joins (Int32 ↔ Int64), short-circuits INNER JOIN immediately with 0 base queries when target pre-filter yields 0 keys (with automatic 10,000-doc safety cap fallback), and places live Copy Pipeline directly beside Run in Join Tab ▶ in JoinViewDialog — stripping UI prefixes, guarding blank keys, placing early $limit before $lookup for unsorted LEFT JOIN, separating top-level indexable target filters from $expr.$and (joinKey0..N), ordering LATEST_ONE as $match → $sort({ _id: -1 }) → $limit: 1, omitting empty $sort: {}, flattening Extended JSON $numberInt sort objects, and outputting JsonMode.RELAXED JSON.

v0.3.0

  • Join Target Tab Bar Refactoring (JoinViewDialog): Removed the standalone right-side Remove button; each join target chip (① collection ×) displays a conditional × close button only when 2+ join targets exist, highlights the active tab, scrolls horizontally when many targets are added, and pairs with an inline textless green + icon button placed right beside the last chip (compatible with Darcula & New UI Dark/Light themes).
  • Real-Time Searchable Field ComboBoxes (SearchableFieldComboBox & FieldSearchFilter): Added instant case-insensitive typing search with prefix-first priority sorting (startsWith before contains), automatic popup opening, detached model replacement (selectedItem = null) preserving exact caret position during continuous typing, arrow/mouse selection conflict guards, and custom nested path support across all join-key mapping (source & target) and WHERE AND condition field selectors.
  • Bidirectional MongoDB & AWS DocumentDB Multi-Key Join Engine + Exact Cached Pagination & JUnit 5 Tests: Keeps native multi-condition $lookup + server paging on standard MongoDB while transparently running a 2-phase hybrid join on AWS DocumentDB (and seamlessly falling back on runtime Error 304): prioritizes unique identifier keys (_id, id, *_id, *Id) in 1st-stage single-key $lookup + 500-item $slice 16MB guard, filters remaining keys precisely via MultiKeyJoinFilterEngine (Int32/Int64 cross-type equality, nested dot-paths, array flattening, INNER/LEFT semantics), and serves zero-gap, zero-duplicate Next/Prev pages from a query-signature-isolated session cache — verified by automated JUnit 5 tests.

v0.2.7

  • Strict BSON Type Preservation & Real-Time Validation in Edit Data: Added focused single-field BSON editor (FieldEditDialog) preserving original BSON types (Int32, Int64, Double, Decimal128, String, Boolean, ObjectId, Date, Null, JSON), real-time DocumentListener validation blocking invalid saves, Date [Now] + live UTC ISO preview, Red (Prod) warning banner, _id & Join/Aggregation/Read-Only guards, and typed $set updateOne matching original _id type (compatible with MongoDB & AWS DocumentDB).
  • Collection JSON Data Import & 4-Stage Atomic Pre-Flight Validation: Added Import JSON Data... in Connections tree and result toolbar supporting single object ({...}), JSON array ([...]), and NDJSON formats, UTF-8 BOM stripping, [.json File] loader (10MB cap), [Format JSON], [Strip existing _id], and [Validate Only (Dry-Run)]. Runs 4-stage Pre-Flight checks (syntax & AWS DocumentDB vs MongoDB key rules, in-batch + chunked DB _id duplicate detection, nested schema type mismatch checks with safe numeric promotion) — atomically aborting with a detailed copyable error report before any DB write, and inserting in 500-doc chunks when clean.

v0.2.6

  • MongoDB Compass-Style 4-Tab Connection Settings & Bidirectional URI Sync: Redesigned connection configuration into 4 tabs (General, Authentication, TLS/SSL, Advanced) with live two-way MongoDB URI sync (RFC-3986 credential encoding, mongodb+srv rules, lossless extra query parameter table), IntelliJ PasswordSafe credential storage, AWS DocumentDB global-bundle.pem multi-CA & client certificate SSLContext support, environment color tags (Dev/Stg/Prod), and non-blocking async Test Connection.
  • Enhanced Connections Tree Context Menu (YAML & Custom): Added IntelliJ New UI native actions for Connection Settings / View URI... (including read-only YAML inspection with [Clone to Custom Connection & Edit...] and [Open Source YAML File]), Copy Connection String / CLI submenu (Full URI, Masked URI, ready-to-run mongosh CLI with TLS/DocumentDB flags), instant client invalidation on Reconnect & Refresh, and visual environment color tags on both tree nodes and workspace tabs.
  • v0.2.5 UX Bug Fixes: Fixed JoinViewDialog join-key list dynamically expanding dialog height up to 3 rows (scrolling for 4+) and removed duplicate + text prefixes on icon buttons; fixed Filter/Sort/Project autocomplete Enter completion leaving newline prefix residue (e.g. {cr}).

v0.2.5

  • Composite Join Keys (Multi-Key AND Matching) & Auto-Match Common Keys: Added dynamic 1..N join key mapping rows in JoinViewDialog with [+ Add Join Condition] and [Auto-Match Common Keys] (appends matching fields without overwriting existing rows).
  • Hybrid $lookup Pipeline & Safety Guards: Uses index-friendly localField/foreignField for single-key joins and automatically switches to MongoDB & AWS DocumentDB (4.0/5.0) compatible let + pipeline (local_k0..kN, null/missing guard, dynamic $cond($isArray), LATEST_ONE $sort/$limit: 1 pushdown) for composite joins, guarded by 15,000ms maxTimeMS and join-key summary badges.
  • Keyboard Navigation for Filter / Sort / Project Autocomplete: Unified high-priority key interception (↑/↓ wrap-around navigation, Enter/Tab context-aware apply without triggering query execution or newline, Esc dismiss, and one-shot reopen suppression until next typing).

v0.2.4

  • Zero-Overhead Initial Collection Open: Completely skips explain() and listIndexes() when opening a collection without Filter/Sort, displaying a neutral No Filter (Preview) badge (click to inspect indexes anytime).
  • Driver & Metadata Performance: Added .limit(N).batchSize(N) single-roundtrip reads, removed full-scan-inducing EXECUTION_STATS fallbacks (QUERY_PLANNER + 1,500ms maxTimeMS only), added 60s TTL caching for estimatedDocumentCount() & listIndexes(), and isolated View/restricted-permission errors safely.
  • UI-First Instant Tab Open, Lazy View Rendering & Single-Flight Control: Opens tabs immediately on first click with an animated loading spinner, builds only the active view (Tree/Table/JSON) off-EDT with safe display truncation for huge strings/arrays/binaries, updates count/explain asynchronously, and cancels stale requests via AtomicLong generation + Future.cancel(true).
  • IntelliJ New UI Native Context Menus & AllIcons: Replaced Swing JPopupMenu with native ActionPopupMenu (setTargetComponent) and crisp 16×16 AllIcons across all Result Tree/Table and Connections Tree menus.

v0.2.3

  • Explain & Unified Index Cache: Hardened multi-tier MongoDB & AWS DocumentDB explain() parsing, explicit UNKNOWN badge with failure tooltip when explain fails, and unified 60s cached index metadata (including index sizes).
  • Read-Only Index Inspector & Query Filter Guide: Click the IXSCAN/COLLSCAN/UNKNOWN badge or right-click any collection in Connections tree to inspect indexes, apply Filter templates, and copy ESR-ordered createIndex recommendations (strictly read-only).
  • 5-Group Context Menu & Multi-Selection Smart Quick Filter/Sort: Reorganized Tree & Table right-click menus with automatic single/multi-cell =, !=, $in, $nin, Date range $gte~$lte, multi-field AND/$or (safe $and wrapping), $exists, and quick Sort.
  • Join View Fixes & Limit Modes: Added array-of-objects dot-notation join keys (e.g. items.product_id), fixed post-join deterministic $sort/$skip/$limit(N+1) paging consistency, and added explicit 20 / 50 / 100 / 500 / Unlimited (5,000 cap) modes.
  • Visual Hierarchy Upgrade: Added active bottom-accent mode tabs (Documents (Find) / Aggregations / Mongo Shell) and an icon-backed segmented control for Tree / Table / JSON.
